svg.title: Schatten - Direct Entra Login (local runtime implemented; production setup pending G/F)

g.text: Schatten - Direct Entra Login (local runtime implemented; production setup pending G/F)
One shared single-tenant confidential registration; separate dev/prod secrets.
Exact tenant issuer; openid profile email; no Graph calls.
No email_verified claim requirement; missing email prevents first linking.
Registration permissions, consent, assignments and callbacks are shared.
Development: https://app.localhost -> local Caddy -> HTTP API / Vite.
Production: https://schatten.lupaus.eu -> Caddy TLS / React -> HTTP API.
Entra Web callback is /api/v1/auth/callback at each exact origin.
Post-logout return is /login at each origin; no Authentik or Traefik.
Local Caddy/direct Entra is implemented; release adapter remains until G.
Fixed Host/proto and trusted client IP
Store hashed state + browser binding, nonce, PKCE
Redeem code with confidential client + verifier
Validate signature, exact issuer, audience, nonce and claims
Existing issuer/subject bindings are not rewritten.
Each environment has an independent database.
Guarded first-link to pre-provisioned User, or exact (issuer, subject)
GET SPA and /api with session cookie
Application data only; no provider token
